_readme: Source of truth for BETWEEN's questions and dares. Shape: MODE -> INTENSITY -> KIND -> [ [category, solo_ok (1/0), text], ... ]. Run `npm run questions` to validate and regenerate supabase/seed_questions.sql, then run that file in the Supabase SQL editor (it only inserts rows that are missing). solo_ok = 1 means it also works when one person is playing alone, so it must not mention other players. ONLINE content must work over chat/voice/video; OFFLINE content must work face to face with no phone or internet. Every item must be optional, consensual and reasonably safe.
